name: SereinNet Kernel
mission: Establish trust, permission and admission before work; govern inter-domain routing without owning destination payload logic.
ownership: Authority: identity/trust, contract containment, permission envelopes, boot admission, Blueprint integrity and Safe/Recovery transitions.
Operations: scheduler, heartbeat, queues, leases, health, audit and recovery after Authority.
Interface: governed Kernel communication after Authority and Operations.
prohibited: No privileged execution without verified Authority.
No self-admission or authority inferred from observation, connectivity, authentication, UMP or confidence.
No direct access to another domain's private state or provider credentials.
No activation of a later branch before its required predecessor passes.
No ordinary writable-state activity may rewrite a Seed.
vocabulary: IDENTITY PERSISTS. STATE EVOLVES. HISTORY REMAINS. AUTHORITY IS CURRENT.
SEREINNET ROUTES; DESTINATION DOMAINS OWN THEIR PAYLOAD LOGIC.
api_boundary: SOURCE DOMAIN API BLUEPRINT -> SEREINNET GOVERNED ROUTE -> DESTINATION DOMAIN API BLUEPRINT; PRO-180 owns the governed routing contract.
security: Default deny; missing, invalid or UNKNOWN foundational trust enters Safe/Recovery.
Kernel cannot authorize itself; Outpost witnesses and independent validation admits the governed transition.
Authority -> Operations -> Interface; GPU control, offline Companion and isolated Gateway follow before Stage 1.
state_evolution: Writable state evolves around the immutable Seed; it does not silently rewrite it.
recovery: OBSERVE -> FIND EARLIEST INVALID/MISSING/UNPROVEN GATE -> REPAIR/RESTORE/RECONSTRUCT ONLY AS REQUIRED -> VERIFY -> REPROVE DEPENDENT FORWARD STATE
A legitimate Seed change is versioned, attributable supersession with the prior version preserved and separately admitted.
self_drift: CURRENT STATE -> COMPARE TO SEED -> CLASSIFY DRIFT -> EVIDENCE -> REPAIR WRITABLE STATE OR GOVERNED SEED-SUPERSESSION PROPOSAL
Compare identity, ownership, prohibitions, API containment, branch order, authority and lineage against the exact Seed digest.
